Overview

Limassol is a city in Limassol District with a population of 183,000. Cyprus’ second-largest city and its main economic hub, a dynamic coastal metropolis known for its marina, wine region, and vibrant nightlife. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 310 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
